findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:981-985 [critical] The preflight launch revalidation callback only compares headHash, materialHash, and storyFilesHash. It does not revalidate the CLI/worktree, Git index, writer identity or lease, provider capability, resource budget, or writable evidence target after preflight and immediately before child launch, so those states can change in the gap and the command can start despite an invalid preflight contract, violating CHK-004:adversarial:0 and allowing nonzero command execution or partial evidence writes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 1626c43455: the launch-boundary callback now compares a canonical snapshot of all causal preflight facts, and checklist-causal-preflight-batch.test.mjs verifies the wiring and metrics response.

findings.desc: High: CertificationWindow accepts a stale causal advisory because CausalDependencyDecision has no current HEAD/materialHash/storyFilesHash binding. In packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:706-718 and 739-748, the decision carries only decision flags plus a self-hash; packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:703-715 verifies only that self-hash and gateAdmissible, then waives material drift whenever causalDecision=advisory and storyFilesHashAdvisory=true. Repro command: node --input-type=module -e with an advisory decision computed at currentMaterialHash=m2, then detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift with live materialHash=m3 and the same storyFilesHash; observed {"decisionCurrentMaterial":"m2","liveMaterial":"m3","causalDecision":"advisory","decisionHashValid":true,"drift":{"drifted":false}}. A stale signed advisory can therefore keep specialized evidence admissible after a further material change; bind the decision to current material/HEAD/storyFilesHash and verify those bindings at consumption.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs plus certification-window-smoke.js: the dependency decision now carries an identity-bound authority signature and certification-window evaluation rejects stale or forged causal advisory identity.

findings.desc: High: the acceptance contract is not currently admissible for B-5a15. acceptance_basis --storyId=B-5a15 --json reports status=invalid, basisStatus=partial, receiptVerification.ok=false with AT_SCOPE_BINDING_MISSING and freshness mismatch; acceptance_topology_check reports structuralPass=false, topologyState=legacy_missing, and AT_MISSING_TOPOLOGY; pre_review_check_read reports PR_ARTIFACT_MISSING; acceptance_rollout_report_read and acceptance_rollout_check both report AR_REPORT_MISSING with receipt=missing and quorum=degraded-or-missing. packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:496-497 reusable is derived only from identity completeness, so fail/timeout/cancelled/partial receipts written at lines 528-553 are cached and returned as reused instead of being re-executed; a transient failed pinned command permanently prevents a later PASS for the same key.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs: failed, timed-out, cancelled, partial, or otherwise non-pass receipts are not reusable and are removed from the single-flight batch before a later PASS can execute.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:688-695 verifyCausalPreflight accepts any ready report with an empty or failed checks map when its caller recomputes readinessHash; executeCausalEvidence then launches the child. This bypasses the required complete CLI/worktree/index/lease/capability/resource/target preflight.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs: verifyCausalPreflight requires the complete canonical check set, all checks to pass, no failedChecks, and a valid readiness hash.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:774-784 treats a missing previous or current materialHash as no material drift and returns fresh/gateAdmissible=true when dependency inputs match. Missing or uncomputable material identity must fall back to strict refusal, otherwise stale evidence can be reused when the hash probe failed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs: missing material identity is incomplete and fails closed with gateAdmissible=false.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:861-867 verifyCausalDependencyDecision checks only a caller-controlled content hash, not a signed producer or authority binding. Changing gateAdmissible=false to true and recomputing _hash verifies successfully, and CertificationWindow then accepts the forged stale decision.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs: dependency decisions bind the identity and advisory fields through an authority signature, so caller-side content-hash recomputation cannot forge a decision.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:392-399 redacts output using key.identity.effectiveEnvironment after secret values were replaced by the same <redacted> placeholder; a command that prints a bare credential value is persisted verbatim in outputTail/outputProbe. The promised bounded redacted receipt therefore leaks raw secrets into the CAS artifact.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bd9ba8e3e9 and verified by causal-evidence.test.mjs: redaction uses the raw effective environment and masks secret-key values before output construction, including short secrets.
